title: StatusChanged
description: Payload: an observation changed status. 'from' is null for the first status. Which transitions are legal, and which need a 'cause', is the status machine's business (src/ledger/status.ts), not the contract's; the contract only says what a cause looks like.

cause.description: Why, when the transition needs one. 'budget-spent' is the only cause of a pause (INV-2). A trigger (new image, correction, model change; catalog refresh has no event yet) is the only cause of resolved -> unresolved; 'eventSeq' names the earlier event that is the trigger.

oneOf.description: The run's budget is spent; the spine pauses and stays queued.
A trigger that is an event in the ledger: an ImageAssetIngested, an IdentityCorrected on this spine, or a RunStarted that changes the models.
The catalog was refreshed. No event type records that yet, so there is no seq to cite.
